Abstract
Detecting financial misstatements is critical for market integrity but
remains challenging due to class imbalance, delayed discovery, and
limited labeled data.
1 Introduction
Financial misstatements, whether arising from fraud or error, pose
significant risks to investors, auditors, regulators, and the broader
financial system.
